input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-v9 in the Lab, from V = Qe * tau, with the 3 occupants as the CO2 source.

steps.why: Rise at the datasheet's minimum elevated speed. With 3 occupants awake (1.14 L/min) and Qe=0.4 m3/min, equilibrium is about 2850 ppm, so a 20 min step (about a quarter of tau=75 min for a first guess V=30 m3) ends near 1600-1700 ppm, several hundred ppm above the start, well under the limits. Hatch held closed.

Decay at full speed: tau = V/Qe about 30 min for the first guess V=30 m3, so about one tau or more. Same hatch position. Total 55 min, under the 60 min ceiling. Record CO2 each minute and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau).

abort.when: CO2 of the Lab at or above 3000 ppm
the device refuses a step's command
the battery's state of charge under 35 percent
a monitored person out of band, the monitoring lost, or one more person (or one fewer) in the Lab

monitoring.reason: The three occupants of the Lab breathe the raised CO2 during the rise.

expected.rise: Lab CO2 climbs from about 1250 ppm to about 1600-1700 ppm at minute 20 (equilibrium about 2850 ppm, never reached). A reading above 2500 ppm, or a rise much faster than this, shows the source or the volume is not as assumed (fewer m3, more CO2, exchange with Hab-B).
expected.decay: After returning to full speed the CO2 falls back towards about 1250 ppm (equilibrium at full speed) with tau about 30 min if V is about 30 m3; the fitted tau times Qe=1 m3/min gives V_lab. A fitted V outside 10-200 m3, or a curve that does not fit one exponential, shows the one-zone hypothesis is wrong.
expected.hab_b: Hab-B CO2 should stay flat; a drift shows the closed hatch exchanges air, which is not measured here.
expected.vitals: Heart rates stay within 45-120 bpm; occupancy stays at 3.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.
The hatch (hatch-1-v9) is held closed during the whole test; the exchange through it is not measured and is not assumed zero (design flow 3 m3/min per the station topology).
The 3 occupants are awake at a constant activity (0.38 L/min each, band 0.26-0.45); the source is held steady.
Effective flow Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed and scales with speed (datasheet); the scrubber lag of 3.33 min is neglected in the fit start.
First guess V_lab = 30 m3 is only used to size the durations.
